name: Biomedical signals
title: Biomedical signal processing
idea: Recover a fetal heartbeat buried under the mother's, from electrodes on the abdomen.
note: DST-SERB funded work on fetal arrhythmia. At Shinkai-Labs, the same denoising ideas power ANCIRS, a communication system for the School of Artillery, Nashik.

name: Medical images
title: Medical image analysis
idea: Read cardiovascular risk from the eye, and Alzheimer's from 3D MRI, while keeping anatomy intact.

name: Few-shot anomaly
title: Few-shot and anomaly detection
idea: Find what is abnormal when only a handful of labelled cases exist.

name: Infrared sensing
title: Infrared sensing and activity
idea: See activity and falls with low-resolution heat, so no camera ever sees a face.
note: The core of my Keio Ph.D.

name: Detection and tracking
title: Detection and tracking
idea: Track drones and radar targets, and say how certain the track is.

name: Edge AI and inspection
title: Edge AI and industrial vision
idea: Run the model where the data is: on a Jetson, a Raspberry Pi, a railway line.
note: Industry consultation for Raspect (Hong Kong) and Alstom (France).
